tool_args.rationale: The training set shows a saturating increase with u_now at the reference gradient and a strong decreasing response as s_grad rises. The selected smooth four-parameter model captures both patterns and fits its parameters numerically from the paid rows; the batch adds enough gradient variation to proceed without another probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It is explicitly nuisance-only and cannot resolve the bridge response.
Ten observations span u_now and s_grad; a compact saturating-response model can now be fitted numerically without another costly batch.
It explains saturation in u_now but not the strong gradient dependence in the branch-discriminating observations.
The observations hold horizon and other state inputs constant and do not expose a trajectory; a multi-state ODE would be underidentified and unnecessarily complex here.
